summary: Iter10 — verified all 3 backlog follow-ups end-to-end with full regression sweep. Backend pytest: iter10_maker_analytics 6/6 PASS in 1.5s; full suite (iter10 + iter9 + iter8 + iter7 + iter6 + iter4 + admin_seo + marketplace + maker_portal) 146/146 PASS (126 in 40.4s without iter8 + 20 in iter8 isolated 8.6s). No regressions vs iter8 report. Frontend Playwright: (1) Forum polling pause/resume CONFIRMED — at /community → Forum tab → ThreadDetail with Page Visibility API stub, observed: visible 13s = 1 poll, hidden 15s = 0 polls, resume +2.5s = 1 immediate catch-up poll. Matches CommunityPage.jsx ThreadDetail useEffect (lines 503-529: visibilitychange listener, document.hidden gate, setInterval(12000), refresh().catch on return). (2) Maker Analytics tab CONFIRMED — admin-tab-makers reveals maker-analytics-tab + maker-analytics-select with 3 maker options. Selecting iron-and-oak fetched GET /api/admin/maker-analytics/iron-and-oak → 200 with full shape: stripe status badge ('Stripe onboarding incomplete'), gross_revenue=$567 / 30d=$567 / 7d=$567 / orders=3, maker_share_gross=$510 / after_refunds=$510 / refunded=$0 / listings=3, top_products (Carved Oak Wedding Monogram x3 $567), payout_totals (succeeded/deferred/reversed/error/cancelled all $0). Note: man-recent-payouts data-testid renders only when list non-empty — 'No payouts yet' fallback shown for iron-and-oak (correct, no Stripe payouts created yet). (3) Google OAuth wiring CONFIRMED — at /community/login [data-testid='community-google-btn'] is a <button> with onClick={googleSignIn} that sets window.location.href = `https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=${encodeURIComponent(origin + '/community/auth/callback')}`. /community/auth/callback route renders <CommunityAuthCallback> with [data-testid='community-auth-callback'] showing 'Missing session_id from Google' for direct visit (expected). Backend 401 (invalid session) + 422 (empty body) regression already covered in iter9 tests.
critical_code_review_comments:
AdminDashboard.jsx MakerAnalyticsTab renders
    only when recent_payouts.length > 0; the empty-state fallback is a plain '

    No payouts yet

    ' without any data-testid. Recommend adding data-testid='man-recent-payouts-empty' to the fallback for testability symmetry. Currently a tester cannot disambiguate 'list missing' vs 'list intentionally empty' from selectors alone.

AdminDashboard.jsx — PayoutTotals 5 buckets (succeeded/deferred/reversed/error/cancelled) are wrapped in a single data-testid='man-payout-totals' grid but individual buckets have no per-bucket data-testid. Spec specifically called out 'man-payout-totals with succeeded/deferred/reversed/error/cancelled' — recommend adding data-testid='man-payout-{key}' on each grid cell so tests can assert bucket values independently.

CommunityPage.jsx ThreadDetail visibilitychange useEffect (line 503) is correct and battery-friendly. Minor improvement: when refresh() catch-up fires on return, it could optionally check document.hasFocus() to skip when window is visible-but-blurred (out-of-tab focus). Not blocking — current behavior is conservative & correct.

Iter8 transfer_group mismatch (Stripe Connect — Transfer.create uses session_id but PaymentIntent uses pre_transfer_group uuid in /app/backend/routers/stripe_connect.py) is STILL present and STILL re-flagged from iter7/iter8 reports. Separate-charge-and-transfer in production will fail to find the linked PaymentIntent. The deferred-path test passes only because Transfer.create is never reached. RE-FLAGGED for E1 — must be fixed before live Stripe.
